_doc: STAGING. General pack. Clue gate is binding: every clue names a position, a time, or a habit — never a category. Base selection avoids letter-sets held by packs without headroom to lend them.

theme.name: The Garden
theme.blurb: Four square feet, one season, and something that was not there in April.

boards.scene: April, and the bed is still an idea

clues.showed: The neighbor, over the fence, exactly how deep and you did it anyway
clues.hoe: Leaned against the fence on day one and not picked up again until June
clues.hose: Dragged out for the first time and kinked in the same place as last year
clues.shed: Opened after five months, and the smell tells you what overwintered in there
clues.sow: Too early, because the one warm week in April lies to everybody
clues.dose: Of feed measured by eye, which is why the label is still full

boards.scene: The week it rains and you do nothing

clues.shower: Arrives the afternoon you finally hand-watered everything
clues.hoe: Left out in it, which is how the handle got that gray furred look
clues.hose: Coiled properly for once, and now it will not be needed for nine days
clues.row: Straight in the plan, and visibly not straight once things come up
clues.sow: Postponed all week, which turns out to have been the right call
clues.horse: On the bag of manure, and the joke about it has been made twice

boards.scene: The first person you show it to

clues.hosted: Two people at the fence for forty minutes, over four square feet
clues.hoe: Handed over so they can try it, and taken back within a minute
clues.hose: Turned on to demonstrate something, and it soaks a shoe
clues.shed: Not opened, because it is not at the stage where it can be opened
clues.set: The tomatoes finally did, and this is the whole reason anyone was invited
clues.dot: Of green on the bare soil that you have to point at twice

boards.scene: The frost that comes after you were sure

clues.bashed: What one night at minus two does to everything you put out on Sunday
clues.bed: Covered with a sheet at eleven at night, in slippers, in the dark
clues.shade: The thing you spent April engineering and now desperately do not want
clues.shed: Raided at midnight for anything flat enough to lay over a row
clues.dash: From the back door to the far end and back, twice, before the temperature drops
clues.head: Of the lettuce, checked first thing, and it has come through fine

clues.wrongs: Committed against the bed in April, all of them now visible at once
clues.grow: What the things you did not plant are doing best of all
clues.row: Identifiable only by memory at this point, and the memory is not reliable
clues.sow: What you swore you would not do this thickly, and did
clues.gowns: What the whole bed needs and what you have run out of cloches for
clues.song: From the phone on the step, the same one, all summer

boards.scene: The week you stop being able to keep up

clues.growth: Six inches in nine days, measured against the same fence post
clues.grow: Faster than you can tie in, which is a good problem and still a problem
clues.row: Closed over entirely, so you now walk the long way round
clues.worth: The argument you have with yourself about the cost of the compost
clues.throw: The old sheet over the whole thing, done fast, done badly, and it works
clues.tow: What the whole thing needs, and what a stake and twine is standing in for

boards.scene: The evening you take something inside

clues.gather: Enough for one meal, in a shirt held out like a bag, at eight at night
clues.earth: Under every fingernail, and it stays there through two washes
clues.gate: Left open, and the argument about it is a whole separate thing
clues.heat: Still coming off the wall at nine, which is why anything ripened at all
clues.hare: The thing you blame, having never actually seen one
clues.great: Said out loud, to nobody, holding four tomatoes

boards.scene: The herbs by the door, which get all the attention

clues.martin: Nesting under the eave, and now the chair has been moved
clues.mint: Planted in the ground once, by somebody who was warned
clues.rain: Enough that the pot by the door has not been watered since May
clues.trim: Done constantly to one plant and never once to any of the others
clues.train: What the beans are supposed to be doing and are refusing to do
clues.aim: For the base of the plant, and miss, and soak the leaves anyway

boards.scene: Staking, and the argument with a plant

clues.merits: A proper cage, and gets a bamboo cane and some string instead
clues.stem: Snapped at the exact moment you were being careful about it
clues.tie: Loose enough to allow for thickening, which nobody does the first year
clues.trim: The lower leaves, on advice you half remember from a video
clues.mist: On the leaves at six in the morning, gone by seven
clues.timer: On the tap, set once, and never adjusted for the rest of the season

boards.scene: Containers, for the things that will not behave

clues.pilots: The potatoes in a bag, as an experiment, and tells nobody in case
clues.pot: Moved four times in one afternoon chasing a patch of sun
clues.soil: Bought in a bag, because the stuff in the ground is clay and you have accepted it
clues.split: The pot, over one winter, from water that got in and froze
clues.slop: Out the bottom the first time you overwater a container
clues.list: On the back of an envelope, of what went where, already inaccurate

boards.scene: What somebody gives you that you did not ask for

clues.gifted: Courgette. Nine of them. By somebody who will do it again next week
clues.dig: A hole for something that arrived in a carrier bag with no warning
clues.fig: In a pot by the wall, kept small on purpose, and it is the pride of the place
clues.tie: In the new thing loosely, next to the label written in someone else's hand
clues.deft: What the person who handed it over is, and you are not
clues.edit: The plan, again, to make room for something you did not choose

boards.scene: August, and the lettuce has made its decision

clues.bolted: Overnight, in the heat, and now it is bitter and four feet tall
clues.bed: Half of it pulled in one afternoon, which feels worse than it is
clues.bolt: On the shed door that has to be lifted and pushed at the same time
clues.bled: The tap, at the end of the season, so the pipe does not split
clues.debt: To the person who told you to sow it in succession
clues.toe: The line about pulling it up now, and lose the argument to yourself
